```{r Step 1: Ingest County Level Covariates, include=TRUE}
countylevel_covars <- read_csv(here("01_tidydata", "countylevel_covars_20102024.csv"))
```

```{r Step 2: Merge County Level Data, include=TRUE}
counties_sf <- counties(cb = TRUE)

countylevel_covars <- countylevel_covars %>%
  rename(GEOID = COUNTYFIPS)

map_data <- countylevel_covars %>%
  left_join(counties_sf, by = "GEOID")

map_data <- map_data %>%
  select(-NAME, -NAMELSAD)


```
